note: Studies of the 14-patient KLHL20 cohort identify the recurrent de novo p.Gly357Arg variant in 11 individuals with variable epilepsy and neurobehavioral phenotypes (ASD and hyperactivity).

evidence.text: In a study of 14 patients with de novo KLHL20 missense variants, 11 harbored the recurrent c.1069G>A (p.Gly357Arg) variant, presenting with intellectual disability, febrile seizures or epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, and hyperactivity.

source.title: De novo missense variants in the E3 ubiquitin ligase adaptor KLHL20 cause a developmental disorder with intellectual disability, epilepsy, and autism spectrum …
source.quote: We studied 14 patients with de novo missense variants in KLHL20, delineating a genetic syndrome with patients having mild to severe intellectual disability, febrile seizures or epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, hyperactivity, and subtle dysmorphic facial features. We observed a recurrent de novo missense variant in 11 patients (NM_014458.4:c.1069G>A p.[Gly357Arg]).
